description: The agentAi module's decision and planning vocabulary (packages/core/docs/game-ai-substrate.md §4 and §7): what an agent could do, which of those it may do, what its goal still wants, and which steps serve it now versus once an earlier step has run. Each case carries src/ai/action-predicates.ts and src/ai/planning-predicates.ts verbatim in its kb — in that order, which is the only order they consult in — followed by the case content, so a harness in any language runs it unaided. Two cases are the file's teeth: a forbidden step that is the cheapest route to the goal and is offered at NO depth, and a permitted, feasible step that is still not takeable because the plan owes it a prerequisite. Regenerate with `npm run ai-corpus`.

cases.name: the-packs-alone-answer-nothing-and-raise-nothing
cases.note: The no-existence_error contract, for the planning half. A KB carrying no goals and no actions must make every planning goal FAIL — the runner throws on a raise, so this case cannot pass by erroring.
kb: candidate_action(A, Act, T) :- nonvar(A), action(Act, _, _, _), action_target_choice(Act, T), feasible(A, Act, T).
action_target_choice(Act, T) :- action_requires_target(Act), action_target_type(Act, Kind), target_kind(T, Kind).
feasible(A, Act, T) :- action_prerequisite(Act, _), prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T).
prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T) :- T \== none, can_perform(A, Act, T).
prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T) :- T \== none, \+ can_perform(A, Act, T), can_perform(A, Act).
permissible(A, Act, T) :- candidate_action(A, Act, T), \+ forbidden(A, Act, T).
forbidden(A, Act, T) :- forbids(_, A, Act, T).
forbidden_by(A, Act, T, Rule) :- forbids(Rule, A, Act, T).
motive_appeal(A, Act, Motive, Drive, Appeal) :- agent_motive(A, Motive, Drive), action_appeal(Act, Motive, Appeal).
pursuing(A, G, P) :- nonvar(A), agent_goal(A, G, P), goal(G, _).
goal_unmet(A, G, C) :- goal_requires(G, C), \+ condition_met(A, C).
plan_step(A, C, Act, T) :- action_achieves(Act, C), permissible(A, Act, T), step_ready(A, Act).
projected_step(A, C, Act, T) :- action_achieves(Act, C), action_target_choice(Act, T), \+ forbidden(A, Act, T).
step_blocked(A, Act, C) :- action_needs(Act, C), \+ condition_met(A, C).
goal_step(A, G, Act, T, C) :- goal_unmet(A, G, C), plan_step(A, C, Act, T).

cases.note: goal_step/5 is the seed of the search: an unmet condition of the goal and a step that is takeable now. With the goal three steps away, nothing is — which is why the planner has to widen rather than stop.
kb: candidate_action(A, Act, T) :- nonvar(A), action(Act, _, _, _), action_target_choice(Act, T), feasible(A, Act, T).
action_target_choice(Act, T) :- action_requires_target(Act), action_target_type(Act, Kind), target_kind(T, Kind).
feasible(A, Act, T) :- action_prerequisite(Act, _), prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T).
prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T) :- T \== none, can_perform(A, Act, T).
prerequisites_hold(A, Act, T) :- T \== none, \+ can_perform(A, Act, T), can_perform(A, Act).
permissible(A, Act, T) :- candidate_action(A, Act, T), \+ forbidden(A, Act, T).
forbidden(A, Act, T) :- forbids(_, A, Act, T).
forbidden_by(A, Act, T, Rule) :- forbids(Rule, A, Act, T).
motive_appeal(A, Act, Motive, Drive, Appeal) :- agent_motive(A, Motive, Drive), action_appeal(Act, Motive, Appeal).
pursuing(A, G, P) :- nonvar(A), agent_goal(A, G, P), goal(G, _).
goal_unmet(A, G, C) :- goal_requires(G, C), \+ condition_met(A, C).
plan_step(A, C, Act, T) :- action_achieves(Act, C), permissible(A, Act, T), step_ready(A, Act).
projected_step(A, C, Act, T) :- action_achieves(Act, C), action_target_choice(Act, T), \+ forbidden(A, Act, T).
step_blocked(A, Act, C) :- action_needs(Act, C), \+ condition_met(A, C).
goal_step(A, G, Act, T, C) :- goal_unmet(A, G, C), plan_step(A, C, Act, T).

cases.note: The same join after two steps of the plan have been carried out and the world has reported them. Now the goal is one takeable step away, and the join says which.
